однократно is a lowercase adverb suitable for cadence rows. keepRepeatLabel handles the once branch separately; the new key is not incorrectly inserted into the existing keep_as_once sentence.

No maxCells/maxChars numeric limit is present on these five keys. Static lengths: effort 6/7/7 Cyrillic characters; cadence 10; tested count clauses 27–29 codepoints. These are static facts, not pixel-fit proof.
The explicit count_display contract preserves raw String(count), including 1.5; do not replace it with locale number formatting despite the general glossary preference.
